author: DaiqingChen
body:
New evidence showed that PODN and PODNL1 should be glycoprotein instead of proteoglycan, because there is no experimental evidence of them having sugar groups. 
Hence moving these two genes from gel phase of interstitial matrix (GO:0140150) to non-collagenous component of interstitial matrix (GO:0140149).

- [x] PODN: Hs: [Q7Z5L7](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q7Z5L7/entry); Mm: [Q7TQ62](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q7TQ62/entry);
- [x] PODNL: Hs: [Q6PEZ8](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6PEZ8/entry); Mm: [Q6P3Y9](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6P3Y9/entry)

Shall we add a reference? @Matrisome
title: Move gene product from gel phase of interstitial matrix (GO:0140150) to non-collagenous component of interstitial matrix (GO:0140149)

> 
> Can we change PODN and PODNL1 to non-collagenous component of interstitial matrix (GO:0140149) from the same paper ?

No really, that paper is saying PODN and PODNL1 should be gel phase of interstitial matrix. New research from Dr. Sylvie Ricard-Blum suggest these two protein only have structural similarity but not enough experiment evidence. We are waiting for a link of reference once it's being published.
